risk_note: RV2 (db/**). Migration 0047 gives app.notify_templates a variant column (default 'default', lowercase snake case CHECK) in a (app_id, code, variant) primary key, and nullable title_override / body_override that may not be blank. The package default wording stays in code (BR-TEXT-09 for trade messages, BR-TEXT-23 for account and risk messages); the override columns only carry admin rewording (orchestrator ruling 11:1x ③). BR-TEXT-23's RISK_STATE_CHANGED has five variants, so one override per code would not fit. Grants unchanged from 0042 (table level). The table was created by B1-12e (0042) and holds no rows, so changing the primary key has no stock risk. The B1-12e rule test's exact column-set and primary-key assertions are synced in the same rule-test commit (ledger test_paths; class 1, label under approvals #24); under CT-06p (#771) only the added and changed tests must be red. Migration number taken as main max + 1 at landing (0045 went to F1-02k #761, 0046 to B1-10a #775).
